quote: Today, AlphaEvolve is generally available (GA) on Google Cloud.
kind_note: evolutionary coding agent: a Gemini-driven search loop offered as a Google Cloud service, not a single shipped model
note: Lab (Google DeepMind / Google Cloud) and kind (harness) notes are only partly right: it is a product built around Gemini models in an evolutionary search loop, and it shipped as a commercial service, so it is dated rather than none_exists. Date source: the GA post's dateline reads July 9, 2026 and its body says 'Today'; the post is the primary source. Secondary reports (gigazine, businesstechnavigator) say July 10, 2026, which conflicts with the Google dateline; I used the Google date. Preview: the Google Cloud post 'AlphaEvolve on Google Cloud' (dateline December 9, 2025) introduced AlphaEvolve 'in private preview' (restricted access via Google Cloud account representatives per a secondary source; the primary post's body is undated). That preview was not public, so it is recorded only as preview_date. The May 2025 DeepMind announcement (academic early access, not public) was not opened and is not used. The 'tier' and 'none_exists' cases do not apply.
